{{Current events|year=2026|month=03|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****Anonymous state intelligence sources tell ''[[The New York Times]]'' that the [[Iran]]ian [[Ministry of Intelligence (Iran)|intelligence ministry]] have signalled to the [[United States]] [[Central Intelligence Agency]] an openness to talks on ‌bringing an end to the war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-intelligence-operatives-signalled-openness-talks-with-cia-end-war-nyt-2026-03-04/ (Reuters)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]
****An Iranian [[ballistic missile]] strikes the [[Al Udeid Air Base]] in [[Qatar]], the largest [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] base in [[Middle East|the region]]. [https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/iran-israel-us-strikes-2026/card/iranian-missile-strikes-biggest-u-s-air-base-in-the-middle-east-qatar-says-yKI2wRCWxfnRaSBSWyxg?gaa_at=eafs&gaa_n=AWEtsqfQMKCO0L29_wj2FntyTj49x6lLBtW1yaHIfz20-WAqSdMATd74p6TkGTCfpi0%3D&gaa_ts=69a82f9e&gaa_sig=zm-FaA1S8o6JTWiTWBP3jLuob7AYfhMTlU7pwCMykxXGPZfQ41Ig7oLXEBMU8P7W3fo_NRedjYG-3upwCA7tFQ%3D%3D (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***[[Sinking of IRIS Dena|Sinking of IRIS ''Dena'']]
****The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian]] frigate {{ship|IRIS|Dena}} is [[torpedo]]ed and [[shipwrecking|sunk]] by [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] [[submarine]] [[USS Charlotte (SSN-766)|USS ''Charlotte'']] in waters off [[Sri Lanka]], killing at least 87 of the 180 people on board, while 32 others are rescued by the [[Sri Lanka Navy]] with 61 remaining missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-101-people-missing-after-submarine-attack-iranian-ship-off-sri-lanka-2026-03-04/ (Reuters)]
***[[Pro-Iranian protests during the 2026 Israeli–United States strikes on Iran]]
****[[United States Marine Corps|U.S. Marine]] veteran [[Brian McGinnis]] interrupts a [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] hearing in protest of the Iran war and is removed by the [[United States Capitol Police]] assisted by US Senator [[Tim Sheehy]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]-[[Montana|MT]]). [https://www.military.com/feature/2026/03/05/brian-mcginnis-removed-senate-hearing-after-protest-over-us-policy-toward-israel.html (Military.com)]
***An [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35]] shoots down an [[Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force|Iranian]] [[Yakovlev Yak-130|Yak-130 fighter jet]] over [[Tehran]] with an [[air-to-air missile]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israeli-air-force-f-35-shoots-down-russian-made-iranian-fighter-jet-over-tehran/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[Turkey]] and [[NATO]] forces shoot down an Iranian ballistic missile that was about to enter Turkish [[airspace]]. [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/turkiye-intercepts-iranian-ballistic-missile-heading-toward-its-airspace-3215600 (Türkiye Today)]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. defense secretary]] [[Pete Hegseth]] announces that the [[United States Air Force|U.S. Air Force]] will have uncontested [[air supremacy]] of Iranian airspace within days, and that Iran's military capabilities are "evaporating by the hour" due to constant U.S. and Israeli strikes. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/mar/04/pete-hegseth-iran-us-israel-war (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Hezbollah–Israel strikes]]
****[[Israel]]i strikes on a hotel and residential areas in the towns of [[Aramoun, Aley|Aramoun]] and Saadiyat, in the south of [[Beirut]], kill eleven people and injure four others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/4/israeli-forces-bomb-hotel-in-beirut-residential-building-in-lebanons-east (Al Jazeera)]
****Three people are killed and six more injured during two Israeli strikes on the road to the [[Beirut–Rafic Hariri International Airport|airport]] in Beirut. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/3/4/iran-live-news-us-embassy-in-dubai-hit-israel-pounds-tehran-beirut?update=4365501 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A task force rescues two minors in an operation against [[FARC dissidents]] in [[El Retorno]], [[Guaviare Department]], [[Colombia]], and arrests four militants and recovers [[M60 machine gun]]s, assault rifles, explosives, and ammunition. [https://www.agenciapi.co/noticia/regiones/operacion-conjunta-de-las-fuerzas-militares-afecta-estructura-martin-villa-del-alias-ivan-mordisco-en-guaviare (Agencia API <small>in Spanish</small>)]
* [[Mexican drug war]]
**Five [[drug cartel|cartel]] members are killed in a shootout with [[Mexican Armed Forces|government forces]] in [[Rayones]], [[Nuevo León]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.milenio.com/policia/enfrentamiento-abatidos-operativo-muralla-rayones-nuevo-leon (''Milenio'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Cuban crisis]]
**[[2024–2026 Cuba blackouts]]
***A major [[power outage|blackout]] across much of western [[Cuba]], including [[Havana]], leaves millions without power, following a fault at the Antonio Guiteras power plant in [[Matanzas]]. Officials estimate it will last at least 72 hours. [https://apnews.com/article/cuba-blackout-power-outage-havana-western-island-f7d1a4927bbcefb774ccf34dbbc9a794 (AP)]
**[[Air France]] announces the suspension of flights between [[France]] and Cuba, starting from March 29 until at least June 15 due to a [[jet fuel]] [[shortage]] in Cuba. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/03/04/air-france-suspend-cuba-service-fuel-shortage/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')]
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran conflict]]
**Several of the [[United Arab Emirates]] [[stock exchange|stock exchanges]] will resume, including [[Nasdaq Dubai]], [[Dubai Financial Market]], and [[Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange]], after being put on pause for two days due to the [[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates|Iranian strikes]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/uae-exchanges-resume-trading-wednesday-2026-03-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Logan Township explosion]]
**Four people are injured after an explosion at an [[oil extraction]] plant in [[Logan Township, New Jersey|Logan Township]], [[New Jersey]], United States. [https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/explosion-logan-township-nj/ (CBS News)]
*At least six people are killed and 15 others are injured when a passenger [[bus]] and a [[semi-trailer truck]] collide in [[Tamacine]], [[Touggourt Province]], [[Algeria]]. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20260305/6a8b8f2823c7470891da335b3e8401b2/c.html (Xinhua)]
*A nationwide [[power outage|blackout]] occurs in [[Iraq]] with the [[Ministry of Electricity (Iraq)|Ministry of Electricity]] saying the [[electrical grid|power grid]] has gone down entirely, and that the cause is under investigation. [https://in-cyprus.philenews.com/international/iraq-blackout-iran-shipping-threat-lebanon-war-day-five/ (Philenews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Banco Master scandal]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Brazil|Supreme Court]] of [[Brazil]] orders the arrest of former Banco Master president and major shareholder [[Daniel Vorcaro]] in a [[fraud]] investigation of potentially up to 12 billion [[Brazilian real|reals]] in missing funds. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-banco-master-bank-fraud-13c9a88612145e7e5fc759c019af2ac2 (AP)]
*[[Hong Kong–mainland China relations]], [[China–United Kingdom relations]], [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]]
**The [[Old Bailey|Central Criminal Court]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], charge two [[British Chinese]] nationals of violating the [[National Security Act 2023|National Security Act]] for [[espionage|spying]] on [[Hong Kongers in the United Kingdom|diasporic Hong Kongers]] on behalf of the [[State Council of China|China]]-appointed [[Hong Kong]] [[government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-hong-kong-spying-trial-3555bb4708cb92ebe56c502d9749d7d7 (AP)]
*[[Scam centers in Cambodia]]
**[[Taiwan]]ese prosecutors indict 62 people, including [[Chen Zhi (businessman)|Chen Zhi]], for their alleged links to the [[Prince Group]], a multinational criminal network that operates [[scam center]]s in [[Cambodia]]. They also charge 13 companies with offences related to the criminal organization and [[money laundering]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/taiwan-indicts-62-linked-to-alleged-scam-center-in-cambodia/a-76207992 (DW)]
*The [[Tokyo High Court]] in [[Japan]] orders the dissolution of the [[Unification Church]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crrxx5x7wyko (BBC News)] [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/03/04/japan/crime-legal/unification-church-ruling/ (''Japan Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–2026 Slovak protests]]
**[[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[Prime Minister of Slovakia|prime minister]] [[Robert Fico]] announces that [[Fico's Fourth Cabinet|his government]] will repeal a [[Law of Slovakia|law]] abolishing the country's [[Whistleblowing|whistleblower]] protection office after the [[Constitutional Court of Slovakia|Constitutional Court]] suspended the measure and the [[European Commission]] opened infringement proceedings against Slovakia. [https://www.indopremier.com/ipotnews/newsDetail.php?jdl=Slovakia_to_repeal_law_abolishing_whistleblower_protection_office__PM (AFP via Indo Premier)]
*The [[United States Senate]] rejects a [[War Powers Resolution]] that would check [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s power in the Iran war, making it the first vote on the conflict in [[United States Congress|U.S. Congress]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-war-senate-vote-war-powers-06f9465c16218f90192f7502baa736eb (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-lawmakers-set-vote-war-powers-iran-conflict-widens-2026-03-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Japanese space program]]
**The [[Space One KAIROS|KAIROS]] rocket developed by [[private spaceflight]] company [[Space One]] suffers its third launch failure from [[Spaceport Kii]] in [[Wakayama Prefecture]], [[Japan]], while carrying a small government test satellite. The flight was terminated two minutes after launch. [https://www.afpbb.com/articles/-/3509701 (AFPBB News)] [https://www.space.com/space-exploration/private-spaceflight/japan-startup-space-one-kairos-third-launch (Space.com)]
